statements.proposition: Template checkbox 'I ran the tests on all platforms and verified they passed' (unticked).
statements.note: Rule 2.2: an unticked checkbox in the PR author checklist template is not a claim; the span begins with '- [ ]'. The whole checklist and platform sub-items in the message are unticked.
evidence: Item message text: '- [ ] I ran the tests on **all platforms** & verified they passed on:' followed by unticked platform sub-items '- [ ] Android: Native' etc.
